summary: Completed testing of CRM Data Isolation, isTienda role, Panel Maestro tabs, and canAccessArmarios permission. Backend: 19/20 tests passed (95%). Frontend: All role-based visibility working correctly. Found critical bug: ContactModel missing 'assignedTo' field.

critical.issue: ContactModel missing 'assignedTo' field - CRM data isolation for contacts cannot work properly because contacts don't have an assignedTo field to filter by
critical.details: The backend filtering code at line 2156 checks for query['assignedTo'] = assignedTo, but the ContactModel (line 427-451) doesn't include an 'assignedTo' field. This means contacts cannot be assigned to comerciales and the filtering will always return empty results for non-admin users.
critical.fix_suggestion: Add 'assignedTo: str = ""' field to ContactModel and ContactCreate/ContactUpdate models
